subject.title: docs: note LanceDB dreaming v0.2.3 via memory-lancedb-dreaming plugin

question: Should official OpenClaw docs include a generic LanceDB/vector-native dreaming caveat, or should this package/version availability stay only on ClawHub?
rationale: The request as written promotes a specific community plugin version, which conflicts with VISION.md’s ClawHub boundary, but the linked PR now proposes generic wording grounded in current slot-owner behavior.

options.title: Sponsor Generic Docs Wording
options.body: Review and land the linked PR with generic active-memory-slot-owner and ClawHub discovery wording, avoiding package/version endorsement.

options.title: Keep Availability On ClawHub
options.body: Close the linked PR and then this issue after stating that specific package/version metadata belongs on ClawHub and the plugin’s own docs.

options.title: Defer To Protocol Work
options.body: Defer any docs caveat until https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/85473 resolves the broader dreaming plugin protocol direction.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Generic Docs Wording
recommendation.body: Review and land the linked PR with generic active-memory-slot-owner and ClawHub discovery wording, avoiding package/version endorsement.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is primarily docs/plugin-boundary policy, and vincentkoc has the strongest recent history on the Dreaming docs and adjacent dreaming/plugin loader surface.
